comingLast.roast: hide his keys, hide his phone, keep him at the bar
1 holes to dodge the double blue - the field is glued to his group
he can still pass Hope - stranger things have happened, rarely to him
current run rate 1.2 - the presentation script has him pencilled in
safe-ish by 1 - the blue balls have come back from further
1 clear - his supporters (his group) keep reminding him loudly
a 1-point moat between him and Hope's crown - shallow moat
safety margin 1 - his playing partners call it 'the plank'
in on a 2-point buffer - watching the door like everyone else
2 above Hope from the clubhouse - it never felt so thin from a chair
